name: ln-pipeline
description: The ln-agents delivery pipeline. A deterministic orchestrator owns every transition; humans sign approvals outside A2A.

skills.name: start_run
skills.description: Create a run from an entry spec at START, then advance it.

skills.name: advance
skills.description: Advance a run until it needs a human, pauses, finishes or runs out of steps.

skills.name: status
skills.description: The run's state: where it is, its status, budget and pause reason.

skills.name: evidence
skills.description: What a human decides on at H1, R1 or R2: the evidence they sign, the choices, who may sign, and a readable Markdown report (written to the run's approvals/ folder).

skills.name: ask
skills.description: Ask the coordinator model a question about a run. It answers in text from the run's Markdown views and changes nothing.

skills.name: approval_document
skills.description: Write the unsigned approval document and return the ssh-keygen and `run decide` commands. The human signs and decides; nothing here approves.
